most_confidently_wrong.question: Should I still use KMS v1 for encryption at rest?
most_confidently_wrong.expected: 1.27 documents KMS v1 as beta; 1.31 says KMS v1 is deprecated since v1.28 and disabled by default since v1.29, use KMS v2
most_confidently_wrong.answer: On 1.31, you should use KMS v2 if feasible because KMS v1 is deprecated (since Kubernetes v1.28) and disabled by default (since Kubernetes v1.29) [v1.31:tasks/administer-cluster/kms-provider#c1]. The 1.27 documentation excerpts do not cover this.

most_confidently_wrong.question: How do I make a Pod run on a specific node using labels?

rows.question: How many minor versions may the kubelet lag behind kube-apiserver?
rows.expected: two on 1.27; three on 1.31
rows.answer: On 1.27, the kubelet may be up to two minor versions older than the kube-apiserver [v1.27:releases/version-skew-policy#c2]. On 1.31, the kubelet may be up to three minor versions older than the kube-apiserver (except for versions < 1.25, which are limited to two) [v1.31:releases/version-skew-policy#c2].

citations.quote: `kubelet` must not be newer than `kube-apiserver`, and may be up to two minor versions older.
`kubelet` may be up to three minor versions older than `kube-apiserver` (`kubelet` < 1.25 may only be up to two minor versions older than `kube-apiserver`).

rows.question: Can I use .spec.ordinals to set a StatefulSet's start ordinal, and is it stable?
rows.expected: yes; beta (v1.27, needs the StatefulSetStartOrdinal gate) on 1.27; stable (v1.31) on 1.31
rows.answer: On 1.27, the start ordinal is set via .spec.ordinals.start and pods will be assigned ordinals from that start value up through start + .spec.replicas - 1 [v1.27:concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset#c7]. On 1.27, the feature state of start ordinal is beta [v1.27:concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset#c7]. On 1.31, the start ordinal is set via .spec.ordinals.start and pods will be assigned ordinals from that start value up through start + .spec.replicas - 1 [v1.31:concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset#c7]. On 1.31, the feature state of start ordinal is stable [v1.31:concepts/workloads/controllers/statefulset#c7].

rows.answer: On 1.31, you mount an OCI image as a volume by setting the `volumes[*].image` field in the pod spec to a valid image reference and then referencing that volume in the container's `volumeMounts` [v1.31:tasks/configure-pod-container/image-volumes#c2]. or modified.
